# Local Hero Post

> > Professional post-production and digital cinema services specializing in color grading, digital intermediate, and VFX workflows.

Local Hero Post is a boutique post-production facility founded by Leandro Marini and Andrew Wahlquist, offering color grading, digital intermediate, and visual effects services. The company works with industry-standard tools like Assimilate Scratch and serves clients including IMAX, Phoenix Pictures, and Mandate Pictures.

## Key Topics

- Color Grading
- Digital Intermediate
- Post-Production
- Visual Effects (VFX)
- Digital Cinema
- Leandro Marini
- Andrew Wahlquist
- Assimilate Scratch
- Film Finishing
- Color Correction
- IMAX
- Real By Fake (RBF)
- RED Camera Workflows
- HDRX Workflow
